ranking_method: Qualitative research priority: first preserve cash and determine executable costs, then test a genuinely different return mechanism only with adequate independent inputs. This is not a numeric probability, investment ranking or post-result change of E01's criteria.

cards.economic_payer: No new payer: savings retain part of an already existing gross opportunity
cards.required_data: Same-time exact-size eligible route quotes with fee decomposition, delay and failure bounds
cards.network_and_size: Potential Base ETH/USDC10/20/25unit observation; no route currently qualified
cards.costs: Pool fees already in a quote must not be charged twice; unmeasured gas/impact/reverts remain unknown
cards.capacity: Cannot be inferred from TVL or candle volume
cards.risk: A cheaper route can have worse safety, latency or adverse selection
cards.test_result: Removing100percent of recorded fees still leaves known six-month ATR paths gross-negative; fee optimization alone does not fix that path
cards.falsifier: No positive gross opportunity or no realizable savings after complete cost and risk comparison
cards.fa: اول باید هزینه واقعی معلوم شود؛ صرفه‌جویی هزینه خودبه‌خود منبع سود جدید نیست. دوره شش‌ماهه نامناسب حتی قبل از کارمزد ثبت‌شده زیان دارد.

cards.economic_payer: Price-risk exposure and possible delayed market adjustment, not a guaranteed losing counterparty

cards.network_and_size: Two Base pools, one100unitaccount,25ordercap; no simultaneous separate100accounts
cards.costs: Both sell and later buy incur scenario fees; oneposition and delayed transition retained
cards.capacity: Only tiny-model notional tested; not a network-liquidity certification
cards.risk: Recent winner selection can pick exhaustion; stops and low entry frequency miss rebound opportunities

cards.economic_payer: Swap users pay fees while LP bears inventory and information risk
cards.required_data: Historical exact position/range/liquidity, realized fees, deposits/withdrawals, independent price marks and operating costs
cards.network_and_size: No actual pool/position chosen or funded; analytical100unit50/50fullrange model only
cards.costs: Entry/exit/rebalance gas, adverse selection and inventory changes; no blind sum of different loss benchmarks
cards.capacity: Active range and crowding matter; not verified
cards.risk: Depeg, range exit, price trend, contract exploit and inability to exit

cards.fa: دریافت کارمزد واقعی است، اما مقدار آن باید از زیان موجودی و هزینه بیشتر باشد. آزمون فعلی فقط حد لازم را حساب کرده؛ سود تاریخیLPساخته نشده است.

cards.economic_payer: Inconsistent prices or segmented demand, offset by competition and financing/execution frictions
cards.required_data: Simultaneous attainable two-leg prices, actual inclusion probability and both funded-leg constraints
cards.risk: Nonatomic legs, finality, fee competition and restrictions; no guaranteed capture
cards.access: No crossborderrestrictioncircumvention or leverage; no actual orders
cards.fa: قیمت متفاوت دو بازار به‌تنهایی آربیتراژ قابل استفاده نیست؛ فعلاً مزیت سرعت، داده و اجرای مجاز و اقتصادی برای حساب کوچک احراز نشده است.

cards.economic_payer: Possible delayed repricing of public information; direction alone not netprofit
cards.required_data: Publication and firstseen timestamps, vintage information, matched controls and latency/cost
cards.risk: Prepricing, fake/duplicate news, lookahead and competition; no private information sought
cards.fa: خبر باید در زمان تاریخی واقعاً در دسترس بوده باشد. خوراک دریافت‌شده امروز را برای تولید سود گذشته استفاده نمی‌کنیم؛ ارزش پیش‌بینی هنوز معلوم نیست.

nontrading_income: Execution technology/services are a real separate business mechanism in C02. No demand, pricing, customers or revenue model for selling Arz is validated. This must never be represented as successful trading PnL.
